reviewContext.userProblem: Service-mode runs (RielaApp / events serve) resolved workflows from the definition store head and never noticed later bundle-file edits (store seeded with defaults.nodeTimeoutMs=3300000, workflow.json edited to 21600000 never reached the store), and LocalProcess deadline timers used DispatchTime uptime (paused during sleep), so ART runs were killed at exactly 3300 s once the host stayed awake; hourly output stopped ~13 h.
requiredOutcomes: Service-mode run with an untouched head (current == lastFileVersionId) and an edited, valid bundle file auto-imports the file as a new audited .import version (actor id service-auto-sync) and uses it.

Independently edited head: no overwrite; definitionStore.sourceDrift warning in stderr, session snapshot diagnostics and riela doctor, with remediation riela instance reload / riela workflow definition import <workflow> --force --reason.
Invalid or missing source file: stored head kept, definitionStore.sourceInvalid / sourceUnavailable warning emitted, run never silently changed or failed.
Existing stores without extra metadata handled by re-canonical digest comparison; seed/import/forceUpdate treated as file-derived; no schema migration.

LocalProcess, step supervisor (SystemWorkflowRetryClock), distributed worker, ACP deadline cancel and file-markdown conversion deadlines fire at the absolute wall-clock Date via an injectable WallClockDeadlineScheduling; docs state timeouts are wall-clock.
swift build, focused swift test filters and changed-file swiftlint --strict pass.
nonGoals: No change to riela instance reload, importDefinition(force:), seedIfAbsent, update/undo/redo/restore/prune or the store schema.
No new WorkflowDefinitionOperation / ActorKind values, GraphQL/SDL changes or new event types.
No change to lookupOnly callers (EventLiveServe, RuntimeEnvironmentPreparation, InstanceReloadSupport fingerprint) or pinned resume/rerun loadPinned.
scheduleKillIfRunning 1 s SIGTERM->SIGKILL grace, WorkflowRuntimeClock, SleepNodeExecution, polling loops, RielaLocalHTTPServer and AppleSpeechRecognition unchanged.
constraints: Work only in worktree /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela-worktrees/stale-definition; never touch the main checkout or its .build.
Do not restart/kill/reconfigure the running RielaApp; do not modify ~/.riela/** or installed binaries; tests use temp stores under tmp/stale-definition/<planId>/.
Do not weaken definition-store conflict safety (staleHead / expectedCurrentVersionId head-aware commits).
Run swift build / swift test / swiftlint via arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc.
Each worker edits only its writePaths and its own impl-plans/progress/<planId>.md.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Drift check runs only in lookupOrSeed service resolution (DefinitionStoreWorkflowBundleResolver.lookup) via WorkflowDefinitionService.syncFromSourceIfUntouched; configured-launch route switches to .lookupOnly.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: One check per launch inside the session so diagnostics persist to the session snapshot; seed() does not check mode so first-use seeding is preserved (design-workflow-definition-store.md §4, §4.1).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: File candidate resolved with an explicit FileSystemWorkflowBundleResolver (sourceFileResolver / passed fileResolver), never the resolver's inner or the service's own fileResolver.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Configured launch hands EditorPreparedBundleResolver(stale stored bundle) as inner; using it would re-import the stale bundle (review finding D1).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Auto-sync writes one .import WorkflowDefinitionWrite with expectedCurrentVersionId = head.currentVersionId; on staleHead/alreadyRegistered/any write error re-read once and emit autoSyncConflict unless the re-read digest equals the file digest.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Respects existing head-aware conflict semantics without retry loops; no new operation enum values (design §4.1 Concurrency).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Classification compares re-canonical document digests; nil baseline falls back to operation-based rule (seed/import/forceUpdate on untouched head => autoSync).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Migration-safe for existing stores without extra metadata; last_file_version_id already NOT NULL since generation 10 (user-qa Q1 2026-11-11).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Single RielaCore primitive WallClockDeadlineScheduling / SystemWallClockDeadlineScheduler / dispatchWallTime(for:) / wallClockSleep(until:scheduler:) using DispatchWallTime at the absolute Date.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: DispatchTime uptime pauses during sleep; every timer enforcing a node/step Date deadline must fire at that wall Date (design-wall-clock-deadlines.md §2-§3).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: riela doctor gains a read-only definitionSources report (pendingAutoSync/drift/sourceInvalid/sourceUnavailable => warning; errors => storeUnreadable/unknown).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Operators see drift without waiting for a service run; doctor never writes or creates a store (design §8).

intentionalTradeoffs: Wall-clock adjustments (NTP/manual) move deadlines; a sleeping host can time out immediately on wake.
Auto-sync is default with no config flag (only untouched heads are synced).
Warnings emitted before a session exists go to stderr only; callee drift diagnostics attach to the callee bundle, not the parent session.
WorkflowDefinitionServiceResolutionTests expectations may change only where a valid post-seed edit is now auto-synced (design §11), each change logged.
supportedEdgeCases: Untouched head + edited valid file => auto-sync; repeated run with unchanged file => inSync, no writes.
Edited head (updatePrompt, undo onto older version) + file edit => drift, no write.
Invalid workflow.json or changed workflowId => sourceInvalid; missing source directory => sourceUnavailable.
Last file op forceUpdate => still file-derived; concurrent head move during sync => autoSyncConflict; concurrent identical auto-sync => no diagnostic, one import audit.
fileDigest equal to current head digest on an edited head => inSync.
Callee workflows in service runs get their own check; one-time riela workflow run leaves zero definition_* rows.
Past deadlines fire immediately; cancellation of wallClockSleep resumes exactly once with CancellationError.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Surfacing callee drift in the parent session or pre-session warnings in persisted diagnostics.
Wall-clock conversion of polling loops, WorkflowRuntimeClock, SleepNodeExecution, HTTP server and speech recognition timers.
residualRisks: Shared .build contention across wave-2 RielaCLITests plans (sdwd-03, sdwd-04): log sibling breaks and re-run, never fix sibling files.
